notes: debugger-agent: root cause was Hero.checkVisibleMobs() using the shared heroFOV array (always recomputed for hero[0]) instead of a per-hero FOV, causing spurious interrupt() for remote heroes and LAN deadlock when curAction was cleared. Fixed in Hero.java checkVisibleMobs(): added LAN guard that recomputes fieldOfView from the remote hero's own position before checking mob visibility.

pr-agent: opened PR at https://github.com/lewibs/shattered-pixel-dungeon-multiplayer/pull/1 with fixes for two LAN desync bugs: (1) Mob.die() using Dungeon.hero instead of killer hero for EXP/loot/talents, (2) receiveActionAsync() race condition in per-stream guard reset. Also extended computeStateHash() to detect desyncs sooner.
